faqs.question: How do I book a travel package with Ventoura Travel?
faqs.answer: Booking is simple! Use our search tool above to find your destination and dates, browse available packages, and click 'Book Now.' You'll be guided through a secure checkout process. Alternatively, call our travel experts at +1 800 555 1234 for personalized assistance. We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible cancellation on most packages. Cancel 30+ days before departure for a full refund. 15–29 days: 75% refund. 7–14 days: 50% refund. We also offer 'Cancel for Any Reason' insurance for complete peace of mind. Full policy details are shown at checkout for each package.

faqs.question: Do you offer travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes! We partner with leading travel insurance providers to offer comprehensive coverage including trip cancellation, medical emergencies, lost luggage, flight delays, and COVID-related disruptions. We strongly recommend adding insurance to every booking. It can be added during checkout at a small additional cost.

faqs.question: Can you help with visa applications?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our dedicated visa team handles applications for 150+ countries with a 99% approval rate. We guide you through the documentation process, fill out forms on your behalf, and track the application status. Most visas are processed within 2–7 business days. Contact us for country-specific requirements.

faqs.question: Is there a best price guarantee?
faqs.answer: Yes! If you find the same package cheaper elsewhere within 24 hours of booking, we'll match the price and give you an additional 5% discount. We work directly with airlines and hotels to negotiate exclusive rates not available elsewhere. Simply contact us with a screenshot of the lower price.

faqs.question: What types of payment do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank wire transfers, and installment plans through Klarna and Afterpay. For bookings over $5,000, we offer 0% interest installment plans up to 12 months.

faqs.question: Do you offer group booking discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes! Groups of 8 or more receive a 10% discount. Groups of 15+ get 15% off plus a dedicated group coordinator assigned to your booking. We specialize in corporate retreats, destination weddings, school trips, and incentive travel. Contact our groups team for a custom quote.

faqs.question: How do I contact support during my trip?
faqs.answer: Every Ventoura traveler has access to 24/7 dedicated support via WhatsApp, phone, and our traveler portal. You'll receive emergency contact numbers and a dedicated concierge before departure to assist with anything from flight changes to local reservations.
